about: ElevenLabs narration, voice 'Quentin – Narrator and Educator' (original file ElevenLabs_2026-10-14T08_37_42_Quentin_-_Narrator_and_Educator_pvc_sp108_s100_sb100_v4.mp3): one continuous 54.5 s read of VO script v2, 44.1 kHz mono MP3. `node tools/vo.js --take vo/source/elevenlabs_quentin_take1.json` cuts it into the 16 cue lines and writes vo/vo.wav with each line's first word on its cue `in` (src/vo_cues.js).
how: src: the source window [s, e] holding exactly one line, cut in the silence between lines (mid-pause). parts: how many speech runs the line has (runs split by pauses of 0.15 s or more); the tool stops if it finds a different count, so a window that drifts onto the wrong line cannot pass. pauses: optional target length (s) for each pause inside the line, in order; null keeps it as read. Only VO-02 and VO-03 are tightened, because the take reads them longer than the picture allows. gainDb: clip gain for one line (VO-02 is read about 3 LU softer than the rest; +2 dB keeps it intimate but clear of the music).
